items.title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
items.en_title: Managed Deep Agents v0.10: Browser Use and Async Subagents
items.en_oneliner: This release lets agents work directly on sites without APIs and sign in themselves, while background subagents handle long-running tasks.

items.title: v2.2.6
items.en_oneliner: Turn on connection pooling and projects with the same setup share one MCP server connection, cutting the process count and speeding up startup.

items.title: How Kiro Auto uses model cascading to match the model to the work
items.en_title: How Kiro Auto uses model cascading to match the model to the work
items.en_oneliner: Kiro's Auto mode cascades models: it opens on a starter model, checks quality in the background, and upgrades to a stronger model when the work demands it.
Claude Code 2.1.319 moves MCP tasks in the terminal to the background as soon as they start, then reports the result to Claude when they finish.
